typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Location as string,
		{Business Service} as string,
		Number as string,
		Opened as date,
		{Short description} as string,
		Priority as string,
		State as string,
		Description as string,
		{Resolution code} as string,
		{Resolution   RFO Notes} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Opened as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		UploadDate as string,
		Description as string,
		Shortdescription as string,
		Priority as string,
		Resolutioncode as string,
		FName as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		BusinessService as string,
		Number as string,
		State as string,
		ResolutionRFONotes as string,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Opened,
		UploadDate,
		Description,
		Shortdescription = {Short description},
		Priority,
		Resolutioncode = {Resolution code},
		FName,
		EtlUser,
		BusinessService = {Business Service},
		Number,
		State,
		ResolutionRFONotes = {Resolution   RFO Notes},
		Location),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
